keyFindings.description: The forward merge 9dae22b733566f90c659ef6b38a457e6051fb6c8 kept main's new paragraph defining the CI line, so the branch now orders the implementer to write the very line it deletes. The paragraph reads 'The CI line names the runs GitHub started for the code head, by run id ... The implementer writes it at its completion from one gh run list --commit <head-sha> ... A later role that reads CI on GitHub updates the line's states to what it read.' Provenance is settled: absent from the fork point 31d58a51174c, present in the main parent 3483129b6e8a (sjawhar/legion#2114), absent from the branch parent 32cb57a0c699ef1e089dfbdc42ec9c6fbd93a3d8, so the resolution re-introduced it on top of this branch's deletion. It contradicts the same file 25 lines above, whose ## Verification template carries no **CI:** line; its last clause is exactly the write-a-check-result-for-a-later-step record this issue exists to remove; and it falsifies packages/pi-legion/CHANGELOG.md:72 and :76-78 and the eleven docs/solutions supersede notes this pull request adds that cite this very file as the proof that the body carries no CI line. No guard catches it: prompts_test.go scans composed prompts only, and skills-guard.test.ts has no CI-line assertion. My own sweep found exactly two hits in the whole of skills/, packages/claude-envoy/legion/ and packages/daemon/internal/prompts/ - this file and its bundle - so the fix is bounded: delete the paragraph and rebuild the bundle. Everything it says that should survive is already in the ## Never waiting on CI section below it, which the merge rightly kept.
